notes.title: Update V1.0.7
notes.content:
General:
[list]
[*] Fixed tutorial quests so you can't get stuck anymore
[*] Fixed Thorns ability so it deals more than 0 damage
[*] Added tooltips in the rest menu
[*] Updated crew screen size

[/list]

Ability Balancing:
[list]

[*] Drain Blood: Increased cooldown: 1 → 2 turns
[/list]

notes.title: Release Update V1.0.6
notes.content:
The release is here, bringing a ton of updates!

Here’s a list of everything new since the demo:
(Current Version: V1.0.6)
[list]
[*] Fixed shadow bugs
[*] Reworked experience scaling
[*] Reworked enemy scaling
[*] Reworked mission scaling
[*] Reworked frustrating missions to no longer require a specific enemy type
[*] Reworked frustrating one-shot mechanics
[*] Added elemental damage types:
[list]
[*] Fire
[*] Ice
[*] Nature
[*] Shadow
[/list]
[*] Added more character stats:
[list]
[*] Spirit power
[*] Physical defense
[*] Elemental resistances
[/list]
[*] Added 13+ abilities for each class
[*] Added ability descriptions
[*] Added NPC "Fatebinder" to learn new abilities
[*] Added "Rune Inscriptions" to increase specific character stats
[*] Added 9 bosses with unique boss maps
[*] Added summer & winter season mechanic
[*] Added tutorial quests and info
[*] Added level info on missions and enemies
[*] Added different elemental colors for all damage types
[*] Added ship rowing animation
[*] Added unconscious mechanic – to prevent immediate death
[*] Updated the story and added many quests
[*] Many smaller updates and fixes
[/list]
